ratings.comment: A brilliant woman who seems to struggle with social interactions. Sometimes also smug and condescending – depending on what she thinks of you. To be fair, I did learn quite a bit from her despite the negative impact she had on my semester.

I found her to be a deeply disrespectful and incompetent professor who bullied students to protect her own interests. How people like her end up in tenure track positions is beyond me but I hope UW wakes up and starts cleaning its ranks of people like her someday. Really disappointing.

Hannah is one of the best professors I've ever had. She cares about her students and is very very knowledgable. She was always willing to answer questions. The assignments for this class were always interesting. Genuinely one of the funnest classes I've taken.

Hannah is very competent to teach this subject and enjoys engaging with the students. This course was EXTREMELY easy. If you participate and do the readings, you'll get an A. The only thing I took issue with was that the grading criteria could be a little more clear. Overall, this was an amazing class and an amazing honors-optional class.

I had done pretty well, or so I thought. The difficulty level and rigor seemed unnecessary. Peers wanted to be successful, myself included but nobody could reach their deserved grades in the end. Intense but why, what benefit or real payoff of coursework? Not worth it.

Definitely knowledgeable in her subject as a professor, which was great. Could be very uncomfortable to talk one on one with her because it was hard to gauge what she thought about you/your work. Fine class, but you have to put in extra work to get an A.

Not gonna lie on this one but I had an excruciating time in this professors class. I often felt singled out even when I know I had completed superior work . All semester long I battled the crazy scoring and ridiculous explanations. The energy is her class was unsettling, spooky even. Idk it left a bruise on my Year to be honest.

I know a few friends who have taken classes from Hannah. I wanted to try something new and was very eager to be in this class; unsure of what I took away. One of those professors that can't see above their own ego to score deserving students highly on multiple pieces of work. I didn't realize this until it was too late. Won't take another.

She is a good professor, very knowledgeable and helpful, however, she assigned so many readings and had papers due almost every week. If you attend class, and put in effort on the papers you should be ok, but the material was also abstract and really boring.
I took this class months ago and had a hard time grasping the grading system all semester; a strange, experience all around.
Should not be teaching in any capacity. choose another class for your required credits.

Hannah is a great professor, very articulate and obviously incredibly intelligent. I learned a lot in her class, but I definitely had to work for it. She is not a particularly hard grader but doesn't just hand out As either. Overall a fantastic experience.
A lot of work but a nice professor, she really facilitates interesting conversation and discussion on the readings. Makes you work for your grade but overall a really nice professor.
incredibly intelligent and articulate; asks thought-provoking questions.

I would not recommend this professor in any capacity. She is incredibly strict, structured, controlling, intimidating, and very arrogant; also does a pretty neat job of making you feel like a 3rd grader in a timeout. Homework and projects are impossible to score perfectly on. This professor gave me such anxiety, I had to go on medication.
